question: Along with Rishabh Pant, how many other athletes were nominated for the 2025 Laureus World Comeback of the Year award?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**5 athletes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Laureus World Comeback of the Year award** is a prestigious honor presented annually to athletes who have overcome significant challenges or adversities to return to their respective sports.
 
• For the **2025 edition** of the award, Rishabh Pant, the Indian cricketer, was nominated along with **5 other athletes.**
 
• This award highlights the **resilience** and determination of athletes who have made remarkable comebacks after setbacks such as **injuries, personal struggles, or other challenges.**
 
• Rishabh Pant’s nomination is significant considering his contribution to **Indian cricket** and his recovery from a serious accident.
 
• Other nominees for the award include athletes from diverse sports, showcasing the global recognition of **comebacks in various disciplines**.
 
• The Laureus awards are often referred to as the **"Oscars of Sports"** and are known for their emphasis on inspiring stories within the sporting community.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Laureus World Sports Academy**__

 __
 
• The Laureus World Sports Academy is an organization established to celebrate the achievements of athletes and the power of sports to bring about social change.
 
• The Academy consists of **legendary athletes** and members who vote for the award winners annually.
 
• The awards cover categories such as **Sportsman of the Year, Sportswoman of the Year, Team of the Year, and Comeback of the Year.**
 
• Since its inception, the Laureus Awards have been a platform to inspire younger generations through the stories of sports heroes.
 
 
 
• **Rishabh Pant’s Comeback Journey**__
 
 
• Rishabh Pant suffered a **near-fatal car accident** in December 2022, which led to serious injuries and subsequent surgeries.
 
• Despite the challenges, he showcased **determination and resilience** in his recovery process.
 
• His journey serves as an **inspiration** for budding athletes and fans worldwide.
